sources.snippet: By Vatsal Bajpai (@xblack) · FrostWolfAI Labs — GGUF quants of Frost-Cyber-Mini-Uncensored-v1.1, a compact, fast, local cybersecurity and software-engineering assistant with an agentic tool-use phase, for red-team, OSINT, CTI, secure coding and agentic workflows.

sources.title: FrostWolfAI/Frost-Cyber-Mini-1.0-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Frost Cyber Mini 1.0 is an uncensored (abliterated) offensive-security model. Its safety filtering is substantially reduced and it will produce exploit code, payloads, and attacker tradecraft on request.
